M005.label: afflicted
M005.quote: The 5th house is spoilt and is a source of worry to the native. A male child was born on 15-10- 1898 and died within one month. Subsequently no otheir issues were born.

M013.label: afflicted
M013.quote: The conjunction of Saturn and Mars, the Moon and Ketu have spoiled the several good indications of the horoscope. The native is unimaginative, miserly, mean, undignified and over-cautious.
M013.note: Character judgment; Raman says all three Lagna factors are unfavourably disposed.

M021.label: afflicted
M021.quote: the ruler of the third becoming combust and hence powerless, renders the third house weak. This stands against his having any brothers.

M029.label: none
M029.note: Raman only records the 1905 marriage to Eleanor in Saturn Dasa; he gives no judgment of the spouse or marital happiness.

M037.label: favourable
M037.quote: The native was a big industrialist and was one of the wealthiest Indians.
M037.note: Also: 'Rahu is well placed in the 11 th or house of gains'.

M045.label: mixed
M045.quote: The 7th lord in the 9th gives a well placed partner. Saturn's association as 5th and 6th lord gives the partner a rigid and conservative nature while the position of Mars as a malefic lord creates tension and quarrels in married life
M045.note: He also says Venus and Jupiter rule out separation or divorce.

M053.label: favourable
M053.quote: Tagore won the Nobel Prize for literature in 1913
M053.note: Remarks also: 'Tagore was known and respected throughout the world'.

M061.label: afflicted
M061.quote: As a result, he lost his first wife and had to marry a second one.

M069.label: afflicted
M069.quote: Pitrukaraka Sun in the 9th is not Quite conducive to happy relations with father. Ford's father was not in sympathy with his bent towards mechanics.
M069.note: Chart 38 is Henry Ford; the conclusion is about the relationship with the father, not his life or longevity.

M077.label: afflicted
M077.quote: The native's wife has separated and he has no children horn to him.

M085.label: afflicted
M085.quote: the Gaekwar was very unfortunate in regard to his children as most of them died during his life-time.

M093.label: favourable
M093.quote: The native has a happy married life.

M101.label: favourable
M101.quote: This gives an exalted nature and a strong will, and renders the horoscope fortified.
M101.note: Said of the unafflicted Vargottama Lagna.

M109.label: afflicted
M109.quote: made the native a revolutionary who was interned for political reasons. The conjunction of the 6th and the 12th lords Venus and Mars respectively are also responsible for the native's incarcerations.

M117.label: afflicted
M117.quote: The aspect of Mars on the 7th house occupied by Ketu has resulted in violent clashes in married life.
M117.note: Jupiter's aspect only prevented a complete break-up 'although life itself is miserable'.

M125.label: favourable
M125.quote: The Moon is also free from afflictions. There is much pride in the mental disposition. The native is a businessman and is well off in life.
M125.note: Physical and character description is largely positive (handsome, generous, resourceful).

M133.label: mixed
M133.quote: explain the native's rise from humble life, his becoming a dictator, and his final violent end.
M133.note: Chart 204 (Mussolini): reached the highest position, then fell.

M141.label: favourable
M141.quote: The native rose to eminence and wealth as a great industrialist from humble beginnings.

M149.label: mixed
M149.quote: Health will be fairly good but occasionally she will suffer from bodily complaints. She lacks self-confidence. She is nervous.
M149.note: Also: during Jupiter's Dasha she suffered considerably from ill-health.

M157.label: favourable
M157.quote: The horoscope is typical for longevity, temperate habits and intellectual attainments.

M165.label: favourable
M165.quote: the blemish-free 7th lords and 7th houses both from Lagna and the Moon have given a happy marriage.

M173.label: mixed
M173.quote: The native is not much educated in the sense of school-going, but she has the capacity of quick comprehension, is well informed and cultured.
M173.note: Formal schooling poor, intelligence and culture good.

M181.label: afflicted
M181.quote: totally blind in his 44th year. The 12th lord Venus is highly afflicted

M189.label: afflicted
M189.quote: The last and the most tragic event is her own death.
M189.note: Remarks also speak of 'her tragic end'.

M197.label: favourable
M197.quote: This combination illustrates the fact that Marx was never in the habit of borrowing but of strongly asserting the results of his own research and of impressing upon other men.
M197.note: Said of exalted Venus in the 2nd (house of speech) and the 2nd lord in his own sign.

M205.label: afflicted
M205.quote: Severe afflictions to the Sun deprive one of father early in life. The ninth house and the ninth lord as well as pitrukaraka are quite heavily afflicted.

M213.label: afflicted
M213.quote: is an unfortunate combination which involved him in trying lawsuits, brought against him by the authorities for his 'obscene writings'.
M213.note: He was prosecuted, not imprisoned: Raman adds 'Ellis himself was not molested.'

M221.label: afflicted
M221.quote: Throughout Saturn Dasha (for the first 12 years) the native suffered from liver and spleen troubles.
M221.note: He also had spermatorrhoea and a hydrocele operation in Mercury Dasha.

M229.label: none
M229.note: No conclusion on business partnership. The only 7th-house conclusion is about marriages: 'Mars aspecting the 7th and the 7th lord in conjunction with Rahu gave two marriages' (first wife died).

M237.label: favourable
M237.quote: The yoga gains some strength as a result of which the native is financially sound.

M245.label: afflicted
M245.quote: There are Bandhana Yogas also present.
M245.note: Later: 'The native was in jail for over a year before he was hanged.'

M253.label: favourable
M253.quote: During Jupiter Dasa the Swami's activities expanded on an international scale and his name became widely known. The Rajayoga part of Jupiter's power became completely manifest.
M253.note: Jupiter is lord of the 9th; Raman gives no separate summary verdict on fortune.

M261.label: favourable
M261.quote: Chart No. 126 is of an international figure in astrology whose predictions have been fulfilled to a remarkable degree.

M269.label: favourable
M269.quote: secondly, he was a great religious disciplinarian.
M269.note: Also: 'He was a Tapasvi in its real sense.'

M277.label: afflicted
M277.quote: Consequently the native did not have any issue.

M285.label: none
M285.note: No conclusion on wealth. The only 2nd-house judgment is about speech (keen debate and effective speaking, favourable).

M293.label: mixed
M293.quote: Such dispositions frequently result in great achievements but as Venus lord of the 6th and 11th also aspects the 9th, the life is often unhappy.
M293.note: Said of the 9th from Chandra Lagna; later the 9th lord's star brought name and fame.

M301.label: mixed
M301.quote: while the subject earns considerable money, the situation of Saturn and Rahu makes him spend his earnings on evil purposes.
M301.note: Then a 'sudden rise and sudden fall': he lost all his fortune and ran up a Rs. 50,000 debt.

M309.label: afflicted
M309.quote: The native, an apostle of non-violence, was assassinated by a fanatic communalist.

M317.label: afflicted
M317.quote: This gave him a lot of opposition
M317.note: Also: 'Vivekananda was the buttend of considerable malevolent interpretations.'
